text:
maria: Heads-up — EU region forecast just landed from demand-ops: expected 2x p99 request volume for the 3-day holiday window. Our current admit curve will push p99 queue depth into 10s of seconds. We should evaluate soft-admit + route prioritization now.
kevin: can you paste the numbers? i want GPU-hour delta and what breaks first (queue vs OOM vs network)
maria: Quick summary:
```
baseline p99 qdepth: 1.2s
forecast multiplier: 1.9x
expected p99 qdepth if unchanged: ~9s
delta GPU-hours/day: +38% (if we keep SLOs and prewarm like today)
```
oliver: ouch. network side? any egress/capacity limits in eu-west1 that would worsen tail?
maria: yes — we have a known egress throttling pattern around 18:00-22:00 CET for that region (partner CDN reaching soft limit). That amplifies queueing because backend retries + slower KV cache misses.
tanvi: two quick levers: (1) temporary VIP prioritization for paid routes (2) adaptive soft-admit that reduces concurrency for non-critical models. both are config only.
kevin: timeline to toggle VIP prioritization? can we make it traffic-keyed so it only affects the top 10% revenue routes?
oliver: VIP toggle is ~30m to expose flag + validate on canary. soft-admit policy change needs a rollout plan (hysteresis) — i can help simulate.
sre-bot: Deploy plan checklist created: /deploys/1924567890-eu-surge. Steps: prepare flags -> canary -> monitor p95/p99 -> ramp. react with :eyes: to acknowledge.
maria: also consider spot-GPU reclaim risk — cloud reports higher preemption probability during surge. we should bias prewarming to reserved pools for VIPs.
tanvi: agreed. reserved pools cost delta estimate: +18% GPU-hours but keeps p99 under 2s for VIPs. worth proposing to finance for a 3-day uplift.
kevin: can we do hybrid: reserved for top 20% routes + soft-admit for rest? numbers?
oliver: rough sim results after 10m run with current traffic traces: VIP reserved + soft-admit => p99 overall ~3.1s, VIP p99 ~1.7s, GPU-hours +22%.
maria: that's acceptable vs +38% if we tried to keep everyone at baseline. decision needed by EOD to lock reservations.
tanvi: i'll draft a short runbook and cost ask for finance. tagging @kevin for final approval. also adding a small admission hysteresis (30s cool-down) to avoid oscillation.
kevin: approved to proceed with hybrid plan. oliver, can you coordinate canary windows and monitoring thresholds? aim to have canary ready in 2 hours.
oliver: on it. will use canary window 17:00-18:00 CET, short TTL, and watch queue_depth.p99, admit.rate, failover.rates.
maria: thanks. final action items: tanvi runbook + cost ask, oliver canary + sim scripts, kevin approve reservation commit, i will notify growth/finance & update portal. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary started: eu-west1 VIP-prioritization flag -> canary 1% at 17:00 CET. Logs: https://internal/deploy/1924567890. Monitor: #metrics-dashboard
kevin: noted. keep alerts loud, we escalate to oncall if p99 > 6s for >2min.
maria: will post postmortem template if anything degrades. otherwise we close after surge window.
